name: Armenia
shortSummary: India has become a significant defence supplier to Armenia in recent years, including Pinaka rocket systems and Akash air defence systems, as Armenia diversifies away from traditional Russian sourcing.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: India has emerged as a notable arms supplier to Armenia, including artillery and air-defence systems.

sources.title: Bilateral brief
sources.publisher: Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India
